<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, viewport-fit=cover">
  <meta name="description" content="好看云壁纸 — 订阅壁纸合辑，持续更新。浏览精选合辑，下载客户端即可订阅与轮播。">
  <title>好看云壁纸 — 展现精彩，看到爱</title>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.5.1/css/all.min.css">
  <style>
    :root {
      --brand: #0f172a;
      --brand-dark: #0f172a;
      --brand-soft: #f4f4f5;
      --cta: #0f172a;
      --cta-hover: #334155;
      --group: #52525b;
      --group-soft: #f4f4f5;
      --text: #0f172a;
      --text-muted: #64748b;
      --muted: #64748b;
      --border: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08);
      --surface: #ffffff;
      --surface-alt: #f8fafc;
      --surface-band: #f1f5f9;
      --nav-h: 64px;
      --radius: 16px;
      --shadow: 0 24px 64px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.12);
      --max-w: 1200px;
      --page-gutter: 16px;
      --safe-top: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px);
      --safe-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px);
      --safe-left: env(safe-area-inset-left, 0px);
      --safe-right: env(safe-area-inset-right, 0px);
      --nav-total-h: calc(var(--nav-h) + var(--safe-top));
      --font-system: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;
      --album-serif: var(--font-system);
      --album-sans: var(--font-system);
      --showcase-cover-w: 328px;
      --album-cream: #fafafa;
    }
    .grain {
      position: relative;
    }
    .grain::after {
      content: '';
      pointer-events: none;
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      opacity: 0.045;
      border-radius: inherit;
      background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 256 256' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='n'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.85' numOctaves='4' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23n)'/%3E%3C/svg%3E");
    }
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; overflow-x: clip; }
    body {
      font-family: var(--font-system);
      color: var(--text); background: var(--surface); line-height: 1.6;
      font-weight: 400;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
      overflow-x: clip;
      padding-left: var(--safe-left);
      padding-right: var(--safe-right);
      padding-bottom: var(--safe-bottom);
    }
    body.nav-open { overflow: hidden; }
    html.scroll-lock,
    body.scroll-lock {
      overflow: hidden !important;
      overscroll-behavior: none;
    }
    body.scroll-lock {
      width: 100%;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
    }
    @media (max-width: 720px) {
      body.scroll-lock {
        position: fixed;
      }
    }
    a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
    button { font: inherit; cursor: pointer; border: none; background: none; }
    img { display: block; max-width: 100%; height: auto; }
    .hidden { display: none !important; }
    .container { width: min(var(--max-w), calc(100% - var(--page-gutter) * 2)); margin: 0 auto; }

    /* ── Nav (Apple-style sticky，与 levect.com 一致) ── */
    .site-nav {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      z-index: 1000;
      height: var(--nav-total-h);
      padding-top: var(--safe-top);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
      backdrop-filter: saturate(180%) blur(18px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: saturate(180%) blur(18px);
      box-shadow: 0 1px 0 var(--border);
      transition: background 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s;
    }

    .site-nav:not(.nav-hydrated) {
      transition: none !important;
    }

    .site-nav:not(.is-scrolled) {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.42);
      box-shadow: none;
    }

    .site-nav.is-scrolled {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.96);
      box-shadow: 0 1px 0 var(--border), 0 4px 24px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06);
    }

    .nav-inner {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 16px;
      width: min(var(--max-w), calc(100% - 40px));
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .nav-brand {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 15px;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      color: var(--text);
      white-space: nowrap;
      min-width: 0;
      flex-shrink: 1;
      margin-left: 12px;
    }

    .nav-brand img {
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .nav-links {
      display: none;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 32px;
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    .nav-links a {
      color: #334155;
      transition: color 0.15s;
    }

    .nav-links a:hover {
      color: var(--text);
    }

    #navOtherPlatform {
      color: #334155 !important;
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    #navOtherPlatform:hover {
      color: var(--text) !important;
    }

    .nav-actions {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 10px 18px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      transition: transform 0.15s, background 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .btn:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

    .btn-primary {
      background: var(--cta);
      color: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.18);
    }

    .btn-primary:hover { background: var(--cta-hover); }

    .btn-brand {
      background: var(--cta);
      color: #fff;
      box-shadow: none;
    }

    .btn-brand:hover { background: var(--cta-hover); }

    .btn-dark {
      background: var(--cta);
      color: #fff;
    }

    .btn-dark:hover { background: var(--cta-hover); }

    .btn-ghost {
      color: var(--text-muted);
      padding: 10px 14px;
    }

    .btn-ghost:hover { color: var(--text); }

    .nav-menu-btn {
      display: flex;
      width: 40px;
      height: 40px;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      border-radius: 10px;
      color: var(--text);
    }

    .nav-menu-btn:hover { background: var(--surface-alt); }

    @media (max-width: 899px) {
      #navOtherPlatform { display: none; }

      .nav-inner {
        gap: 8px;
        width: calc(100% - 24px);
      }

      .nav-brand {
        font-size: 13px;
        gap: 8px;
        margin-left: 4px;
      }

      .nav-brand img {
        width: 28px;
        height: 28px;
      }

      .nav-actions {
        gap: 6px;
      }

      .nav-actions .btn {
        padding: 8px 12px;
        font-size: 12px;
      }

      .nav-menu-btn {
        width: 36px;
        height: 36px;
        flex-shrink: 0;
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 400px) {
      .nav-inner {
        gap: 6px;
        width: calc(100% - 16px);
      }

      .nav-brand {
        font-size: 12px;
        gap: 6px;
      }

      .nav-brand img {
        width: 24px;
        height: 24px;
      }

      .nav-actions .btn {
        padding: 7px 10px;
        font-size: 11px;
      }

      .nav-menu-btn {
        width: 36px;
        height: 36px;
      }
    }

    .mobile-drawer {
      position: fixed;
      inset: var(--nav-total-h) 0 0 0;
      background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.4);
      z-index: 999;
      opacity: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      transition: opacity 0.25s;
    }

    .mobile-drawer.open {
      opacity: 1;
      pointer-events: auto;
    }

    .mobile-drawer-panel {
      background: #fff;
      padding: 12px 24px 32px;
      max-height: calc(100dvh - var(--nav-total-h));
      overflow-y: auto;
      -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
      transform: translateY(-8px);
      transition: transform 0.25s;
    }
    .mobile-drawer-head {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
      padding-bottom: 8px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    .mobile-drawer-head span {
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--muted);
    }
    .mobile-drawer-close {
      width: 44px;
      height: 44px;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      border-radius: 10px;
      color: var(--text);
    }
    .mobile-drawer-close:hover { background: var(--surface-alt); }

    .mobile-drawer.open .mobile-drawer-panel {
      transform: translateY(0);
    }

    .mobile-drawer a {
      display: block;
      padding: 14px 0;
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--text);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    }

    .mobile-drawer .btn {
      width: 100%;
      margin-top: 16px;
    }

    @media (min-width: 900px) {
      .nav-links { display: flex; }
      .nav-menu-btn { display: none; }
    }

    /* ── 主内容区 ── */
    #features { scroll-margin-top: var(--nav-total-h); }
    #featuredPicks { scroll-margin-top: var(--nav-total-h); }
    .home-concept {
      margin-top: 28px;
      padding: 32px 24px 36px;
      text-align: center;
      border-radius: 20px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.72);
      border: 1px solid rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.05);
    }
    .home-concept-eyebrow {
      font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.06em;
      color: #94a3b8; margin-bottom: 10px;
    }
    .home-concept h3 {
      font-size: clamp(20px, 3vw, 26px); font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em; line-height: 1.25; margin-bottom: 10px;
    }
    .home-concept-desc {
      max-width: 520px; margin: 0 auto 18px;
      font-size: 14px; color: var(--text-muted); line-height: 1.7;
    }
    .home-concept-tags {
      list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0;
      display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; gap: 8px;
    }
    .home-concept-tags li {
      padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 999px;
      font-size: 12px; color: #475569;
      background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.04);
      border: 1px solid rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06);
    }
    @media (max-width: 720px) {
      .home-concept { padding: 24px 16px 28px; }
    }
    .page-section { padding: 32px 0 64px; }
    .page-section.has-nav-offset { padding-top: calc(var(--nav-total-h) + 16px); }
    .page-section.alt { background: rgba(248, 250, 252, 0.88); }
    #view-home .page-section { padding-top: 36px; padding-bottom: 36px; }
    #view-home { padding-top: var(--nav-total-h); }
    .section-head { margin-bottom: 28px; }

    .btn-muted { background: #e2e8f0; color: #475569; }
    .btn-outline { background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--text); }
    .btn-sm { padding: 7px 14px; font-size: 12px; }

    /* ── 全局壁纸背景（原 Hero 审美，固定于页面底层） ── */
    .site-bg {
      position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: -1; pointer-events: none;
      background: #dce0ea;
    }
    .site-bg-grid {
      position: absolute; inset: 0; overflow: hidden;
    }
    .bg-tile {
      position: absolute; border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: 0 12px 36px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.14);
      transform-origin: center center;
      opacity: 0.92;
    }
    .bg-tile img { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; }
    .bg-tile--landscape { width: clamp(200px, 22vw, 300px); aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; }
    .bg-tile--portrait { width: clamp(128px, 14vw, 200px); aspect-ratio: 9 / 16; }
    .site-bg-mask {
      position: absolute; inset: 0;
      background:
        linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55) 0%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.82) 28%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.94) 52%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.98) 100%),
        radial-gradient(ellipse 90% 60% at 50% 18%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35) 0%, transparent 70%);
    }

    @media (max-width: 699px) {
      .bg-tile--landscape { width: clamp(120px, 32vw, 180px); }
      .bg-tile--portrait { width: clamp(84px, 22vw, 120px); }
      .bg-tile { border-radius: 10px; opacity: 0.85; }
      .site-bg-mask {
        background:
          linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.62) 0%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88) 24%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.96) 48%, #fff 100%),
          radial-gradient(ellipse 88% 50% at 50% 12%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5) 0%, transparent 65%);
      }
    }

    /* ── 主内容区（续） ── */
    .section-head h2 { font-size: clamp(22px, 3vw, 28px); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.03em; }
    .section-head p { font-size: 15px; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 6px; }

    /* ── Banner：3D 叠卡轮播（Coverflow） ── */
    .banner-carousel { margin-bottom: 28px; overflow: visible; }
    .banner-section { width: 100%; overflow: visible; }
    .banner-stage {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
      overflow: visible;
    }
    .banner-coverflow {
      width: min(100%, 980px);
      margin: 0 auto;
      overflow: visible;
    }
    .banner-viewport {
      position: relative;
      width: 100%;
      height: clamp(188px, 34vw, 320px);
      perspective: 1600px;
      overflow: visible;
    }
    .banner-track {
      position: relative;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      transform-style: preserve-3d;
    }
    .banner-track--animating .banner-card {
      transition-duration: 0.82s;
    }
    .banner-card {
      position: absolute;
      left: 50%;
      top: 50%;
      width: clamp(220px, 78vw, 520px);
      aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;
      padding: 0;
      margin: 0;
      border: 3px solid #fff;
      border-radius: 16px;
      cursor: pointer;
      text-align: left;
      background: #e2e8f0;
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.10);
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%) translateX(0) rotateY(0deg) scale(0.72);
      opacity: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 1;
      filter: brightness(0.88);
      transition:
        transform 0.78s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.12, 0.64, 1),
        opacity 0.52s ease,
        box-shadow 0.52s ease,
        filter 0.52s ease;
    }
    .banner-card img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      display: block;
      transition: transform 0.78s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.12, 0.64, 1);
    }
    .banner-card--center {
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%) translateX(0) rotateY(0deg) scale(1) translateZ(48px);
      opacity: 1;
      pointer-events: auto;
      z-index: 3;
      filter: brightness(1);
      box-shadow: 0 18px 44px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.16);
    }
    .banner-card--left {
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%) translateX(calc(-84% - 16px)) rotateY(22deg) scale(0.84) translateZ(12px);
      opacity: 1;
      pointer-events: auto;
      z-index: 2;
      filter: brightness(0.94);
    }
    .banner-card--right {
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%) translateX(calc(84% + 16px)) rotateY(-22deg) scale(0.84) translateZ(12px);
      opacity: 1;
      pointer-events: auto;
      z-index: 2;
      filter: brightness(0.94);
    }
    .banner-card--hidden {
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%) translateX(0) rotateY(0deg) scale(0.66) translateZ(-80px);
      opacity: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 0;
      filter: brightness(0.85);
    }
    .banner-nav {
      position: absolute;
      top: 50%;
      z-index: 30;
      width: 40px;
      height: 40px;
      padding: 0;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.42);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.34);
      color: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.46);
      cursor: pointer;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      box-shadow: none;
      transform: translateY(-50%);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      transition: background 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease, transform 0.15s ease, opacity 0.2s ease;
    }
    .banner-nav i {
      font-size: 13px;
      opacity: 0.88;
    }
    .banner-nav-prev { left: clamp(6px, 2vw, 16px); }
    .banner-nav-next { right: clamp(6px, 2vw, 16px); }
    @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
      .banner-nav:hover {
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.58);
        border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.62);
        color: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.68);
        box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08);
      }
    }
    .banner-nav:active {
      transform: translateY(-50%) scale(0.94);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.52);
      color: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.62);
    }
    .banner-dots {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }
    .banner-dot {
      position: relative;
      width: 8px;
      height: 8px;
      padding: 0;
      border: none;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.16);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: width 0.25s ease, background 0.25s ease;
    }
    .banner-dot::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: -12px;
    }
    .banner-dot.active {
      width: 22px;
      background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.72);
    }
    @media (max-width: 720px) {
      :root {
        --mobile-showcase-w: 100%;
        --showcase-cover-w: 100%;
      }
      .banner-coverflow {
        width: 100%;
        max-width: 100%;
        margin-left: auto;
        margin-right: auto;
      }
      .banner-viewport {
        width: 100%;
        height: auto;
        aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;
      }
      .banner-card { border-radius: 12px; border-width: 0; }
      .banner-nav {
        width: 44px;
        height: 44px;
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.30);
        border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.38);
        color: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.42);
      }
      .banner-nav i { font-size: 12px; }
      .banner-card {
        width: 100%;
        aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;
      }
      .banner-card--left {
        transform: translate(-50%, -50%) translateX(calc(-84% - 10px)) rotateY(18deg) scale(0.80) translateZ(8px);
      }
      .banner-card--right {
        transform: translate(-50%, -50%) translateX(calc(84% + 10px)) rotateY(-18deg) scale(0.80) translateZ(8px);
      }
    }
    @media (max-width: 480px) {
      .banner-card--left {
        transform: translate(-50%, -50%) translateX(calc(-72% - 6px)) rotateY(16deg) scale(0.82) translateZ(6px);
      }
      .banner-card--right {
        transform: translate(-50%, -50%) translateX(calc(72% + 6px)) rotateY(-16deg) scale(0.82) translateZ(6px);
      }
    }

    /* ── 精选合辑 · 响应式网格（手机 1 列 / PC 4 列） ── */
    #featuredPicks {
      font-family: var(--album-sans);
      margin-bottom: 28px;
    }
    #featuredPicks .featured-picks-head {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      text-align: center;
    }
    #featuredPicks .featured-picks-title {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      margin: 0;
      font-family: var(--album-serif);
    }
    #featuredPicks .featured-picks-title-main {
      font-size: clamp(22px, 3vw, 28px);
      font-weight: 400;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      color: #0a0a0a;
    }
    #featuredPicks .featured-picks-grid-wrap {
      overflow: visible;
      padding: 8px 0 4px;
    }
    #featuredPicks .featured-picks-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      grid-auto-rows: auto;
      align-items: start;
      justify-items: center;
      gap: 16px;
      padding: 8px 2px 4px;
    }
    #featuredPicks .featured-pick-card {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      width: var(--showcase-cover-w);
      min-height: 0;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      height: auto;
      padding: 0;
      border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);

    const cfg = DOWNLOAD_CONFIG.android;
    const deeplink = cfg.market;
    let timer = null;
    const cleanup = () => {
      if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
      window.removeEventListener('pagehide', cleanup, true);
      window.removeEventListener('blur', cleanup, true);
      document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', onHide, true);
    };
    const onHide = () => { if (document.visibilityState === 'hidden') cleanup(); };
    window.addEventListener('pagehide', cleanup, true);
    window.addEventListener('blur', cleanup, true);
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', onHide, true);
    window.location.href = deeplink;
    timer = setTimeout(() => {
      cleanup();
      window.location.href = cfg.fallback;
    }, ANDROID_FALLBACK_DELAY);

        existing.dataset.smartBound = '1';

  function normalizeImageKey(url) {
    if (!url) return '';
    return String(url).replace(/@![^/?#]+/, '').split('?')[0];
  }

  function uniqueGalleryImages(urls) {
    const seen = new Set();
    const out = [];
    for (const url of urls) {
      if (!url) continue;
      const key = normalizeImageKey(url);
      if (seen.has(key)) continue;
      seen.add(key);
      out.push(url);
    }
    return out;
  }

  function resolveBannerAlbum(b) {
    if (!b) return null;
    if (b.action?.type === 'album') {
      return findProduct(b.action.target) || null;
    }
    const title = String(b.title || '').trim();
    if (!title) return null;

    const byName = CAT_PRODUCTS.find(p => p.name === title);
    if (byName) return byName;

    const byTitleContains = CAT_PRODUCTS
      .filter(p => p.name && (title.includes(p.name) || p.name.includes(title)))
      .sort((a, b) => b.name.length - a.name.length)[0];
    if (byTitleContains) return byTitleContains;

    const byArtist = CAT_PRODUCTS.find(p => {
      const artist = String(p.artist || '').trim();
      return artist && (artist === title || title.includes(artist) || artist.includes(title));
    });
    return byArtist || null;
  }

  function normalizeBannerIndex(i) {
    const n = visibleBannerItems().length;
    if (!n) return 0;
    return ((i % n) + n) % n;
  }

  function getBannerOffset(idx, active, count) {
    let diff = idx - active;
    if (diff > count / 2) diff -= count;
    if (diff < -count / 2) diff += count;
    return diff;
  }

  function applyBannerLayout(instant) {
    const count = visibleBannerItems().length;
    const track = bannerTrackEl || document.getElementById('banner-track');
    if (!track || !count) return;
    if (!instant) {
      track.classList.add('banner-track--animating');
      clearTimeout(track._bannerAnimTimer);
      track._bannerAnimTimer = setTimeout(() => track.classList.remove('banner-track--animating'), 820);
    }
    track.querySelectorAll('.banner-card').forEach(el => {
      const idx = parseInt(el.dataset.idx, 10);
      const offset = getBannerOffset(idx, bannerIndex, count);
      el.classList.remove('banner-card--left', 'banner-card--center', 'banner-card--right', 'banner-card--hidden', 'active');
      if (offset === 0) {
        el.classList.add('banner-card--center', 'active');
        if (!instant) resetBannerSlideMotion(el.querySelector('img'));
      } else if (offset === -1) {
        el.classList.add('banner-card--left');
      } else if (offset === 1) {
        el.classList.add('banner-card--right');
      } else {
        el.classList.add('banner-card--hidden');
      }
    });
  }

  function resetBannerSlideMotion(img) {

    const count = visibleBannerItems().length;

    bannerIndex = next;
    applyBannerLayout(instant);

    const action = b.action || {};

    const target = action.target || action.url || action.href || '';

  function bindBannerSwipe() {
    const viewport = document.getElementById('banner-viewport');
    const track = bannerTrackEl || document.getElementById('banner-track');
    if (!viewport || !track || viewport.dataset.swipeBound) return;
    viewport.dataset.swipeBound = '1';

    let startX = 0;
    let startY = 0;
    let tracking = false;
    let activeCard = null;

    const resetTracking = () => {
      tracking = false;
      activeCard = null;
    };

    const finishGesture = (x, y) => {
      if (!tracking) return;
      const dx = x - startX;
      const dy = y - startY;
      const card = activeCard;
      resetTracking();

      if (Math.abs(dx) >= 48 && Math.abs(dx) >= Math.abs(dy) * 1.2) {
        bannerDidSwipe = true;
        goBanner(dx < 0 ? bannerIndex + 1 : bannerIndex - 1);
        resetBannerTimer();
        return;
      }

      if (card && track.contains(card)) {
        bannerSuppressClick = true;
        activateBannerCard(parseInt(card.dataset.idx, 10));
        window.setTimeout(() => { bannerSuppressClick = false; }, 0);
      }
    };

    viewport.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
      if (e.touches.length !== 1 || e.target.closest('.banner-nav')) return;
      activeCard = e.target.closest('.banner-card');
      startX = e.touches[0].clientX;
      startY = e.touches[0].clientY;
      tracking = true;
    }, { passive: true });

    viewport.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
      if (!tracking) return;
      const touch = e.changedTouches[0];
      if (!touch) return resetTracking();
      finishGesture(touch.clientX, touch.clientY);
    }, { passive: true });

    viewport.addEventListener('touchcancel', resetTracking, { passive: true });
  }

  function formatIphonePreviewDate() {
    const d = new Date();
    const weekdays = ['星期日', '星期一', '星期二', '星期三', '星期四', '星期五', '星期六'];
    return `${d.getMonth() + 1}月${d.getDate()}日 ${weekdays[d.getDay()]}`;
  }

  function refreshIphonePreviewTimes(root) {
    const scope = root || document;
    const time = formatIphonePreviewTime();
    const date = formatIphonePreviewDate();
    scope.querySelectorAll('[data-iphone-lock-time]').forEach(el => { el.textContent = time; });
    scope.querySelectorAll('[data-iphone-lock-date]').forEach(el => { el.textContent = date; });
  }

  function startLightboxClock() {
    stopLightboxClock();
    const tick = () => {
      const lb = document.getElementById('lightbox');
      if (!lb?.classList.contains('open') || lightboxState.mode !== 'mobile') return;
      refreshIphonePreviewTimes(document.getElementById('lightboxDesktop'));
    };
    tick();
    lightboxClockTimer = setInterval(tick, 1000);
  }

  function stopLightboxClock() {
    if (lightboxClockTimer) {
      clearInterval(lightboxClockTimer);
      lightboxClockTimer = null;
    }
  }

  function buildIphone17Mockup(wallUrl) {
    const wallStyle = wallUrl ? ` style="background-image:url(${JSON.stringify(wallUrl)})"` : '';
    const lockTime = formatIphonePreviewTime();
    const lockDate = formatIphonePreviewDate();
    return `
      <div class="iphone-mock iphone-mock--17">
        <span class="iphone-mock-btn iphone-mock-btn--vol-up" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        <span class="iphone-mock-btn iphone-mock-btn--vol-down" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        <span class="iphone-mock-btn iphone-mock-btn--power" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        <div class="iphone-mock-frame">
          <div class="iphone-mock-screen">
            <div class="iphone-mock-wall" data-iphone-wall${wallStyle}></div>
            <div class="iphone-mock-ui" aria-hidden="true">
              <div class="iphone-mock-lock">
                <div class="iphone-mock-lock-date" data-iphone-lock-date>${lockDate}</div>
                <div class="iphone-mock-lock-time" data-iphone-lock-time>${lockTime}</div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="iphone-mock-island" aria-hidden="true"></div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>`;
  }

  function buildMacDesktopMockup(wallUrl) {
    const wallStyle = wallUrl ? ` style="background-image:url(${JSON.stringify(wallUrl)})"` : '';
    return `
      <div class="mac-mock">
        <div class="mac-mock-frame">
          <div class="mac-mock-screen">
            <div class="mac-mock-wall" data-mac-wall${wallStyle}></div>
            <div class="mac-mock-ui">
              <div class="mac-mock-menubar">
                <div class="mac-mock-menubar-left">
                  <strong>Finder</strong>
                  <span>文件</span><span>编辑</span>
                </div>
                <div class="mac-mock-menubar-right">
                  <span class="mac-mock-bolt" aria-hidden="true"></span>
                  <span>100%</span>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div class="mac-mock-dock-wrap">
                <div class="mac-mock-dock" aria-hidden="true">
                  <span class="mac-mock-app mac-mock-app--finder"></span>
                  <span class="mac-mock-app mac-mock-app--blue"></span>
                  <span class="mac-mock-app mac-mock-app--white"></span>
                  <span class="mac-mock-app mac-mock-app--pink"></span>
                  <span class="mac-mock-app mac-mock-app--yellow"></span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="mac-mock-stand" aria-hidden="true">
          <div class="mac-mock-stand-neck"></div>
          <div class="mac-mock-stand-base"></div>
        </div>
      </div>`;
  }

  function setDeviceWall(root, url) {
    const wall = root?.querySelector?.('[data-mac-wall], [data-iphone-wall]');
    if (wall) wall.style.backgroundImage = url ? `url(${JSON.stringify(url)})` : 'none';
  }

  function ensureLightboxDeviceMockup(mode) {
    const host = document.getElementById('lightboxDesktop');
    if (!host) return host;
    const needMobile = mode === 'mobile';
    const hasMobile = !!host.querySelector('[data-iphone-wall]');
    const hasDesktop = !!host.querySelector('[data-mac-wall]');
    if (needMobile && !hasMobile) host.innerHTML = buildIphone17Mockup('');
    else if (!needMobile && !hasDesktop) host.innerHTML = buildMacDesktopMockup('');
    if (needMobile) refreshIphonePreviewTimes(host);
    return host;
  }

  function resolveLightboxMode(opts = {}) {
    if (opts.mode === 'mobile') return 'mobile';
    if (opts.mode === 'desktop') return 'desktop';
    return 'card';
  }

  function openLightbox(urls, idx, title, opts = {}) {
    lightboxState = {
      urls,
      idx: ((idx % urls.length) + urls.length) % urls.length,
      title,
      mode: resolveLightboxMode(opts),
    };
    updateLightbox();
    const lb = document.getElementById('lightbox');
    lb.classList.add('open');
    if (!lb.dataset.scrollLocked) {
      lb.dataset.scrollLocked = '1';
      lockPageScroll();
    }
    if (lightboxState.mode === 'mobile') startLightboxClock();
  }
  function closeLightbox() {
    stopLightboxClock();
    closeLightboxPrompt();
    const lb = document.getElementById('lightbox');
    lb.classList.remove('open', 'lightbox--desktop', 'lightbox--mobile');
    if (lb.dataset.scrollLocked) {
      delete lb.dataset.scrollLocked;
      unlockPageScroll();
    }
    resetPageScrollLockIfIdle();
  }
  function renderLightboxThumbs() {
    const host = document.getElementById('lightboxThumbs');
    if (!host) return;
    const { urls, idx, mode } = lightboxState;
    const i = ((idx % urls.length) + urls.length) % urls.length;
    const isDevice = mode === 'desktop' || mode === 'mobile';
    host.classList.toggle('is-mobile-ratio', mode === 'mobile');
    if (!isDevice || urls.length <= 1) {
      host.hidden = true;
      host.innerHTML = '';
      return;
    }
    host.hidden = false;
    host.innerHTML = urls.map((u, n) => `
      <button type="button" class="lightbox-thumb${n === i ? ' is-active' : ''}" data-lb-thumb="${n}">
        <img src="${esc(u)}" alt="" loading="lazy">
      </button>`).join('');
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      host.querySelector('.lightbox-thumb.is-active')?.scrollIntoView({ inline: 'center', block: 'nearest', behavior: 'smooth' });
    });
  }

  function setLightboxTitle(title, index, total) {
    const el = document.getElementById('lightboxTitle');
    if (!el) return;
    el.innerHTML = `${esc(title)} <em>${index + 1} / ${total}</em>`;
  }

  function updateLightbox() {
    const { urls, idx, title, mode } = lightboxState;
    const i = ((idx % urls.length) + urls.length) % urls.length;
    lightboxState.idx = i;
    const lb = document.getElementById('lightbox');
    const url = urls[i] || '';
    lb.classList.toggle('lightbox--desktop', mode === 'desktop');
    lb.classList.toggle('lightbox--mobile', mode === 'mobile');
    if (mode === 'desktop' || mode === 'mobile') {
      const deviceHost = ensureLightboxDeviceMockup(mode);
      setDeviceWall(deviceHost, url);
      setLightboxTitle(title, i, urls.length);
      renderLightboxThumbs();
      if (mode === 'mobile' && lb.classList.contains('open')) startLightboxClock();
      else stopLightboxClock();
    } else {
      stopLightboxClock();
      document.getElementById('lightboxImg').src = url;
      setLightboxTitle(title, i, urls.length);
      renderLightboxThumbs();
    }
  }

  function switchNav(nav) {
    currentNav = nav;
    if (nav !== 'home') closeAlbumDetail();
    hideViews();
    const map = { home: 'view-home', settings: 'view-settings' };
    document.getElementById(map[nav])?.classList.remove('hidden');
    if (nav === 'home') resetBannerTimer();
    if (nav === 'settings') renderSettings();
    closeMobileMenu();
    closePlatformMenu();
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
  }

  function initNavScroll() {
    const nav = document.getElementById('siteNav');
    const onScroll = () => nav.classList.toggle('is-scrolled', window.scrollY > 24);
    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
    onScroll();
    requestAnimationFrame(() => nav.classList.add('nav-hydrated'));
  }

  async function init() {
    initNavScroll();

    window.handleSmartDownload = handleSmartDownload;
    window.togglePlatformMenu = togglePlatformMenu;
    window.closeMobileMenu = closeMobileMenu;
    window.closeSoonModal = closeSoonModal;

    updateSmartLabels();
    // 预取 Mac / Windows 安装包地址，点击时可直接跳转
    Promise.all(['mac', 'win'].map((p) => fetchVersionMarket(p).catch(() => '')))
      .then(() => {
        updateSmartLabels();
        buildPlatformMenu();
      });
    initMobileMenu();
    initSiteBg();

    await loadBootstrapData();
    const sharedAlbumId = getShareAlbumIdFromUrl();
    if (sharedAlbumId) await openSharedAlbumFromUrl(sharedAlbumId);
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      initBanner();
      initFeaturedPicks();
      buildPlatformMenu();
    });

    document.querySelectorAll('[data-nav]').forEach(el => {
      el.addEventListener('click', e => { e.preventDefault(); switchNav(el.dataset.nav); });
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-nav-link]').forEach(a => {
      a.addEventListener('click', e => { e.preventDefault(); switchNav(a.dataset.navLink); });
    });
    document.querySelector('.nav-brand')?.addEventListener('click', e => {
      e.preventDefault(); switchNav('home');
      window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
    });
    document.querySelector('.nav-links a[href="#featuredPicks"]')?.addEventListener('click', e => {
      e.preventDefault(); scrollToFeaturedPicks();
    });
    document.querySelector('#mobileDrawer a[href="#featuredPicks"]')?.addEventListener('click', e => {
      e.preventDefault(); closeMobileMenu(); scrollToFeaturedPicks();
    });
    document.getElementById('footerDownload').addEventListener('click', e => { e.preventDefault(); handleSmartDownload(); });
    document.getElementById('footerOtherVersions').addEventListener('click', togglePlatformMenu);
    const platformMenuQr = document.getElementById('platformMenuQr');
    platformMenuQr?.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => clearTimeout(platformMenuQrTimer));
    platformMenuQr?.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => hidePlatformMenuQr());
    document.getElementById('footerProductIntro').addEventListener('click', e => {
      e.preventDefault(); scrollToFeaturedPicks();
    });
    document.getElementById('downloadModalPrimary').addEventListener('click', () => { document.getElementById('downloadModal').classList.remove('open'); handleSmartDownload(); });
    document.getElementById('downloadModalDismiss').addEventListener('click', () => document.getElementById('downloadModal').classList.remove('open'));
    document.getElementById('downloadModal').addEventListener('click', e => { if (e.target.id === 'downloadModal') document.getElementById('downloadModal').classList.remove('open'); });
    document.getElementById('projectModalPromptDownloadBtn')?.addEventListener('click', () => { handleProjectModalPromptDownload(); });
    document.getElementById('projectModalPromptDismiss')?.addEventListener('click', closeProjectModalPrompt);

    document.getElementById('lightboxPromptDownloadBtn')?.addEventListener('click', () => downloadPromptDesktop('lightbox'));
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-qr-tab]').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => setPromptQrTab(btn.dataset.qrScope || 'lightbox', btn.dataset.qrTab));
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-dl-tab]').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => setPromptDesktopTab(btn.dataset.dlScope || 'lightbox', btn.dataset.dlTab));
    });
    document.getElementById('lightboxPromptDismiss')?.addEventListener('click', closeLightboxPrompt);

    document.getElementById('projectModalBackdrop')?.addEventListener('click', closeAlbumModal);

    document.getElementById('lightboxClose').addEventListener('click', closeLightbox);
    document.getElementById('lightboxPrev').addEventListener('click', () => { lightboxState.idx--; updateLightbox(); });
    document.getElementById('lightboxNext').addEventListener('click', () => { lightboxState.idx++; updateLightbox(); });
    document.getElementById('lightbox').addEventListener('click', e => {
      const thumb = e.target.closest('[data-lb-thumb]');
      if (thumb) {
        lightboxState.idx = parseInt(thumb.dataset.lbThumb, 10);
        updateLightbox();
        return;
      }
      if (e.target.id === 'lightbox') closeLightbox();
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('#lightbox [data-action]').forEach(btn => btn.addEventListener('click', () => promptDownload(btn.dataset.action)));
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-action="upload-photo"]').forEach(btn => btn.addEventListener('click', () => promptDownload('upload')));

    document.getElementById('wechatMask').addEventListener('click', () => document.getElementById('wechatMask').classList.remove('show'));
    document.addEventListener('click', e => {
      if (!e.target.closest('#platformMenuShell') && !e.target.closest('#navOtherPlatform') &&
          !e.target.closest('#footerOtherVersions') && !e.target.closest('.platform-link')) {
        closePlatformMenu();
      }
    });
    document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        if (document.getElementById('lightboxPrompt')?.classList.contains('open')) {
          closeLightboxPrompt();
        } else if (document.getElementById('projectModalPrompt')?.classList.contains('open')) {
          closeProjectModalPrompt();
        } else if (document.getElementById('lightbox').classList.contains('open')) closeLightbox();
        else if (document.getElementById('projectModal')?.classList.contains('open')) closeAlbumModal();
        document.getElementById('downloadModal').classList.remove('open');
        document.getElementById('soonModal').classList.remove('open');
        closeMobileMenu();
        closePlatformMenu();
      }
    });
    window.addEventListener('resize', closePlatformMenu);
    window.addEventListener('pageshow', resetPageScrollLockIfIdle);
    resetPageScrollLockIfIdle();
  }

  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
